fields.name: remaining_path
fields.description: An ordered list of menu letters encoding the demonstrated traversals not yet completed in execution, including the traversal to command at this decision step. Decode the demonstration into individual moves between adjacent target sites, preserving repeated visits and reversals. Larger destination x means robot-left; smaller destination x means robot-right. A leftward move along the image-upper arc is A, a rightward move along the image-lower arc is B, a leftward move along the image-lower arc is C, and a rightward move along the image-upper arc is D. Judge the arc from the intermediate wrist trajectory relative to the line joining its resting positions at the two target sites, not by comparing wrist height directly with target coordinates. Target highlight changes identify arrivals; small coordinate fluctuations and briefly simultaneous highlights do not constitute extra moves. At the first execution decision, record the entire decoded demonstration. At each subsequent decision, remove the single leading move completed during the intervening oracle execution. Do not remove the move being chosen at the current decision. Thus episode 0 has ["B","B"] then ["B"]; episode 19 has ["A","B","A","D"], ["B","A","D"], ["A","D"], ["D"]; episode 58 has ["D","D","A","A"], ["D","A","A"], ["A","A"], ["A"]; episode 86 has ["A","C","A","B","D"], ["C","A","B","D"], ["A","B","D"], ["B","D"], ["D"]; episode 99 has ["A","B","C","D"], ["B","C","D"], ["C","D"], ["D"]. After the final traversal completes, the value is []. e.g. ["A","B","A","D"]
